title: HooksConfigSchema
description: Google Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks configuration schema (hooks.json).

enabled.description: Whether this hook group is active.

PreToolUse.description: Interceptors triggered before tool execution (matcher + hooks groups).

PostToolUse.description: Interceptors triggered after tool execution completes (matcher + hooks groups).

PreInvocation.description: Interceptors triggered before model API invocation. Canonical form is a plain list of handlers (matcher is ignored); the matcher-group form is accepted for compatibility.

PostInvocation.description: Interceptors triggered after model API response. Canonical form is a plain list of handlers (matcher is ignored); the matcher-group form is accepted for compatibility.

Stop.description: Interceptors triggered when agent execution halts. Canonical form is a plain list of handlers (matcher is ignored); the matcher-group form is accepted for compatibility.

handlerList.description: Plain list of hook handlers (used by PreInvocation, PostInvocation, Stop; matcher is ignored).

command.description: Shell script or binary executable command path.
